notes.title: Fantasy Adventure Builder Release!
notes.content:
Hello Fantasy Quests Creators,

[i]We are happy to announce that Fantasy Adventure Builder is now released and available on Steam![/i]
With this tool, you get: 

[list]
[*]The famous Tome of Adventure Design book, by Matt Finch, in digital form to generate hundreds and hundreds of quest ideas for your D&D-like games.
[*]A tool to create your custom random generators and share them with the Steam community via Steam Workshop.
[/list]

[u]You're always welcome to join [url=https://discord.gg/brave-alice-games-830368074183737385]Brave Alice Games[/url] and give us your feedback and future ideas![/u]

[i]Enjoy and keep creating![/i]

[b]Brave Alice Games, Mythmere Games[/b]
